entries.odia: ବାପ ଦେହେରି, ପୁଅ ପୁଜାରି, ଗଣ୍ଡି ମଣ୍ଡ ସବୁ ତୁମ୍ଭରି
entries.title: Every role in the same hands
entries.literal_meaning: Father is the deity’s servant, son the priest; body and head are all yours.
entries.explanation: The father-and-son pairing gathers the roles into one circle. The dictionary explicitly explains the saying as “you have become all-in-all here.” Our reading follows the teasing accusation of concentrated control: who is left to question a decision? The image does not establish wrongdoing by a family or religious occupation. Its application to a modern committee is our own.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାପ ଓ ପୁଅଙ୍କ ଭୂମିକାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ି ସବୁକିଛି ଗୋଟିଏ ପରିସରରେ ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରେ—ତୁମ୍ଭେ ଏଠାରେ ସର୍ବେସର୍ବା ହୋଇଛ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ କ୍ଷମତା ଏକାଠି ହୋଇଯିବାର ଟାହି ଅଛି: ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତିକୁ ପଚାରିବାକୁ ଆଉ କିଏ ରହିଲା? ଏହା କୌଣସି ପରିବାର ବା ଧାର୍ମିକ ବୃତ୍ତିର ଦୋଷର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। ଆଜିର ସମିତି ସହ ତୁଳନା ଆମର ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ।
entries.english_summary: The source’s all-in-all gloss gives a teasing picture of concentrated authority.
entries.odia_summary: ସର୍ବେସର୍ବା ହୋଇ ବସିବାର ଟାହି ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଆସେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: At a club meeting, the same two people write the rules, approve the spending and decide every complaint. A member quotes the father-and-son line and asks for another person to review decisions. No actual religious institution or family is being described.
entries.cultural_context: The headword is marked Sambalpur regional usage, not an exclusive origin. Religious roles supply the image; no present community practice or universal family trait is inferred.

entries.odia: ପଥ ପଚାରି ବାପଘର ଯିବୁ ଆଉ ଅଯୋଧ୍ୟାକୁ ମନ ନ କରିବୁ
entries.title: Asking the way home
entries.literal_meaning: You will ask the way to your father’s home; do not set your mind on Ayodhya as well.
entries.explanation: The line contrasts asking directions to a familiar home with wishing for another destination. The dictionary defines the father’s home in a bride’s context but gives no figurative-use gloss. Our reading hears a sharp challenge to an ambition: first consider the knowledge needed for the journey. That challenge can itself be questioned; needing directions does not prove someone incapable of learning or travelling.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାପଘରର ପଥ ପଚାରିବା ସହ ଅଯୋଧ୍ୟାକୁ ମନ କରିବାର ବିରୋଧ ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ବାପଘରକୁ ବଧୂର ପିତୃଗୃହ ବୋଲି ବୁଝାଏ, ରୂପକ ବ୍ୟବହାରର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଦିଏନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଆକାଂକ୍ଷା ପ୍ରତି ଏକ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଅଛି—ଯାତ୍ରା ପାଇଁ କଣ ଜାଣିବା ଦରକାର? କିନ୍ତୁ ପଥ ପଚାରିବାରୁ କେହି ଶିଖିବା ବା ଯାତ୍ରା କରିବାକୁ ଅଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears an ambition challenged through a contrast between two journeys.
entries.odia_summary: ଦୁଇ ଯାତ୍ରାର ବିରୋଧରେ ଆକାଂକ୍ଷା ପ୍ରତି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone planning a long trip asks how to find the nearby bus office. A friend teasingly quotes the line. The traveller answers that asking now is part of preparing, and they work out the route together. This response questions the taunt rather than accepting a limit on the traveller.
entries.cultural_context: Ayodhya remains the named destination; no pilgrimage, distance, route, epic episode or restriction on women’s travel is established. The imagined reply is editorial, not part of the saying.

entries.odia: ଝିଅ ହୋଇ ଯେବେ ଚୂଲିମୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ନ ହେଲା, ତା ଜନମଟା ବୃଥା
entries.title: When a skill becomes a verdict
entries.literal_meaning: If, being a girl, she is not fit for kitchen work, her birth is wasted.
entries.explanation: The conditional turns a cooking expectation into a verdict on a girl’s entire life. The dictionary places this line under the act of cooking. Our critical reading questions that leap: a useful skill becomes a measure of human worth, imposed by gender. The source preserves the harsh judgment; it does not supply our rejection of it.
entries.meaning_odia: ରୋଷେଇର ଯୋଗ୍ୟତାକୁ ଏଠି ଝିଅର ସମଗ୍ର ଜୀବନର ରାୟ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ପାକକର୍ମ ଅର୍ଥରେ ଏହି କଥା ଦିଏ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ସେହି ଡେଇଁବାକୁ ପଚାରେ: ଗୋଟିଏ ଦରକାରୀ କୌଶଳ କିପରି ଲିଙ୍ଗ ଆଧାରରେ ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ମାପେ? କଠୋର ରାୟଟି ଉତ୍ସରେ ଅଛି; ତାହାକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିବା ଆମର ପଢ଼ା।
entries.english_summary: Our critical reading questions measuring a girl’s worth by cooking ability.
entries.odia_summary: ରୋଷେଇରେ ଝିଅର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ମାପିବାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପଚାରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: During a discussion of household expectations, a reader quotes the line. Another replies that everyone can learn useful kitchen skills, while nobody’s life becomes worthless for lacking one. They discuss sharing the work instead of testing only daughters. This is an invented critical conversation, not evidence of a traditional reply.
entries.cultural_context: Two related quotations occur in this one headword. They document gendered language, not the beliefs of every family or a named community. No origin date or endorsement is supplied.
